bundle.shortDescription: Install QuakeWorld (nQuake) into a folder you choose.
bundle.longDescription: The nQuake web installer in its own window: downloads ezQuake, MVDSV, KTX, maps and textures straight into a folder you pick, with nothing else installed on your system.
